observation_window.sampling: provider default; not continuous motion capture

observation.setting: Stage performance in a large auditorium or theater with stage lighting, smoke effects, and a seated audience visible in the foreground; a backing band and choir are positioned upstage.
observation.dancers: A large group of male dancers in the foreground, with an accompanying instrumental and vocal group on the upstage riser.
observation.formation_and_space: Dynamic formations including lines, scattered groupings across the stage floor, a circle formation, and acrobatic pyramids/lifts.
observation.posture: Upright and proud torso with chest open, knees flexing deeply into squats and lunges, weight shifting dynamically across the feet.
observation.footwork: Energetic steps on the balls of the feet, rapid foot beats, leaping, and sliding across the floor on knees; precise step details are obscured by low-resolution wide shots and stage smoke.
observation.arms_and_hands: Arms held wide, reaching outward, or overhead in fist/open hand positions, sometimes raised in pairs during partner lifts.
observation.hips_and_torso: Torso remains relatively stable and upright while performing deep leg extensions, lunges, and turns; minimal hip isolations.
observation.partnering: Group lifts and acrobatic formations where multiple dancers support a dancer balanced atop them.
observation.levels_jumps_turns: Frequent high leaps, spinning turns, sliding drops to knees, and vertical stacking into multi-tier human pyramids.
observation.costume_and_props: Dancers wear dark black fitted tunics with white piping and chest decoration, matching trousers, boots, and headwraps/caps; musicians wear light-colored traditional tunics.
observation.cannot_infer: Precise individual foot placement and weight transfer cannot be determined due to stage smoke, lighting glare, and wide-angle camera framing.

signature_moments.what: Dancers execute synchronized high leaps with extended legs while sweeping arms outward through smoke.
An acrobatic lift where a dancer is held horizontally in a split atop supporting dancers.
A multi-tier pyramid formation where a dancer plays a long horn instrument at the peak.
